fato_historico: 1979: A 106-car Canadian Pacific freight train carrying explosive and poisonous chemicals from Windsor, Ontario, Canada derails in Mississauga, Ontario.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you channel your intense inner focus toward renewal. Much like a heavy burden being released from the tracks of life, you may find that letting go of past pressures clears your path forward. It is a good time to navigate your emotions with grace, perhaps finding strength in the quiet wisdom hidden beneath your surface.
frase_do_dia: The strength to let go is the power to rise again.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of cycles and the beginning of new wisdom.
conselho: Trust your intuition and release what no longer serves your spiritual journey.
